jobs.occupation: R-1187720 Project Management Office (d/f/m) Foods Germany (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027.

JOB PURPOSE

This role exists to act as a key link between global, regional, and local stakeholders, providing broad cross-functional exposure and fostering collaboration across Unilever and the future separated Foods business.

You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and coordinate a major business transformation initiative in Germany.
- Track milestones, manage dependencies, and resolve roadblocks.
- Coordinate transition services planning and costing with local and global stakeholders.
- Support knowledge transfer and data migration activities.
- Act as the main point of contact for project escalations and issue resolution.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, HR, Operations) to ensure timely delivery of key milestones.
- Engage with local, regional, and global stakeholders to drive alignment and project success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, finance or economics.
- Experience working within a large, complex, matrix organization.
- Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work effectively across functions and seniority levels.
- Excellent communication, influencing, and alignment skills.
- Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Proven ability to drive results through teams without direct line management responsibility.
- Excellent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in PMO, business transformation, separation, integration, or large-scale change projects.
- Experience working with senior regional and global stakeholders.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU:

- 38-hour work week with flexible hours and the option for remote work
- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off
- Meal allowance: €65 per month
- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance
- Company pension & shares
- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices
- Discounts via Corporate Benefits
- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike
- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform
- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service
- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!
